text: To develop intravital criteria of the reparative processes following myocardial infarction, clinical, biochemical, and morphological parallels were traced in 62 patients who died of myocardial infarction at different times after the onset of the disease. It was demonstrated that a set of laboratory techniques (examinations of haptoglobin, chloride-soluble mucoprotein, and heterogeneity of mucoprotein, v2-macroglobulin) helps in evaluating the severity of the inflammatory and macrophage reactions in the peri-infarct zone. A useful intravital sign of the formation of a post-infarction scar is provided by examining collagen metabolites—oxyproline bound with collagen-like plasma protein and free serum oxyproline and urinary excretion of total oxyproline. The obtained data can be used for developing a rehabilitation program, differentiated treatment in various patient groups.
